fullPassage: The adolescent brain is not fully developed until its early twenties. This means the way the adolescents' decision-making circuits integrate and process information may put them at a disadvantage. One of their brain regions that matures later is the prefrontal cortex, which is the control center, tasked with thinking ahead and evaluating consequences. It is the area of the brain responsible for preventing you from sending off an initial angry text and modifying it with kinder words. On the other hand, the limbic system matures earlier, playing a central role in processing emotional responses. Because of its earlier development, it is more likely to influence decision-making. Decision-making in the adolescent brain is led by emotional factors more than the perception of consequences. Due to these differences, there is an imbalance between feeling-based decision-making ruled by the more mature limbic system and logical-based decision-making by the not-yet-mature prefrontal cortex. This may explain why some teens are more likely to make bad decisions.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: playing: 분사구문 — 콤마 뒤 동시동작을 나타내는 현재분사
det.analysis: 주절(the limbic system matures earlier) 뒤 콤마+분사구문이므로 play → playing (동시동작 '~하면서')
det.tip: 콤마 + ~ing = 분사구문 (동시동작/부연)

questions.passage: It is the area of the brain responsible for preventing you from sending off an initial angry text and __________(modify) it with kinder words.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: modifying: 병렬구조 — from sending ... and (from) modifying 동명사 병렬
det.analysis: 전치사 from 뒤 동명사 sending과 and로 연결되는 병렬구조이므로 modify → modifying
det.tip: from A and B(동명사 병렬): sending ... and modifying

questions.passage: The adolescent brain is not fully developed until its early twenties. This means the way the adolescents' decision-making circuits integrate and process information may put them at a disadvantage. One of their brain regions that matures later is the prefrontal cortex, which is the control center, tasked with __________ and evaluating consequences. It is the area of the brain responsible for preventing you from sending off an initial angry text and modifying it with kinder words. On the other hand, the limbic system matures earlier, playing a central role in processing emotional responses. Because of its earlier development, it is more likely to influence decision-making. Decision-making in the adolescent brain is led by emotional factors more than the perception of consequences. Due to these differences, there is an imbalance between feeling-based decision-making ruled by the more mature limbic system and logical-based decision-making by the not-yet-mature prefrontal cortex. This may explain why some teens are more likely to make bad decisions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 thinking ahead(앞을 내다보는 사고)가 적절 — 전전두엽은 앞을 내다보고 결과를 평가하는 역할
det.analysis:
❌ ① acting quickly: 빠르게 행동하는 — 통제 중추 기능과 반대
✅ ② thinking ahead: 앞을 내다보는 — 원문 그대로 ← 정답
❌ ③ giving up: 포기하는 — 문맥과 무관
❌ ④ looking back: 되돌아보는 — 문맥과 불일치
det.tip: tasked with thinking ahead = 앞을 내다보는 일을 맡은

questions.passage: The adolescent brain is not fully developed until its early twenties. This means the way the adolescents' decision-making circuits integrate and process information may put them at a disadvantage. One of their brain regions that matures later is the prefrontal cortex, which is the control center, tasked with thinking ahead and evaluating consequences. It is the area of the brain responsible for preventing you from sending off an initial angry text and modifying it with kinder words. On the other hand, the limbic system matures earlier, playing a central role in processing emotional responses. Because of its earlier development, it is more likely to influence decision-making. Decision-making in the adolescent brain is led by emotional factors more than the perception of consequences. Due to these differences, there is an imbalance between feeling-based decision-making ruled by the more mature limbic system and logical-based decision-making by the not-yet-mature prefrontal cortex. This may explain why some teens are more likely to __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 make bad decisions(나쁜 결정을 내리다)가 적절 — 뇌 발달의 불균형이 십대의 나쁜 결정을 설명
det.analysis:
❌ ① solve hard problems: 어려운 문제를 풀다 — 문맥과 무관
❌ ② avoid all risks: 모든 위험을 피하다 — 문맥과 반대
✅ ③ make bad decisions: 나쁜 결정을 내리다 — 원문 그대로 ← 정답
❌ ④ follow strict rules: 엄격한 규칙을 따르다 — 문맥과 무관
det.tip: why some teens make bad decisions = 왜 일부 십대가 나쁜 결정을 내리는가
